data.narrative:
Notus Autonomous Systems is a seed-stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $500K. The valuation analysis draws from a comparative set spanning 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) in the same sector and stage band, including companies such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yields $1.25M. Peer-median benchmarking across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—produces a median of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0M to $805M, with a median of $351M. This wide spread reflects substantial dispersion in the peer set: early-stage defense autonomy companies exhibit a 32x valuation spread. Key uncertainties include whether Notus's technology and team align with high-end comparables like UFORCE or occupy a lower position in the maturity spectrum. Stage-progression implies $1M; peer-median implies $700M. The appropriate valuation depends critically on product differentiation, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the named peer cohort.
